A page can’t change your brightness, so this is a dark veil with the remaining time and breath cue showing through. Tap anywhere to wake it.

Guide

A calm voice talks you through the first minute, then leaves you to the sound. Three neural voices are built into the app, so it sounds the same on every phone. Pick the one you like and hear it before you commit.

Headphones on, volume low. The beat is made in your brainstem, not in the air, so louder does not entrain harder. On iPhone, set the ring/silent switch to ring. Space starts and pauses, Esc ends.

Session shape

Why 6 Hz

Sound engineering

mode · carrier · noise · breath · bells
Beat mode

Target beat
8 Hz

Anything from 0.5 to 40 Hz. The session shape, carrier and mode follow the target automatically; above 30 Hz the beat switches to monaural because a binaural beat that fast is barely perceived.

Carrier
200 Hz

Beats are only perceived on carriers below about 1 kHz and are strongest near 400–500 Hz. Lower carriers, 180–250 Hz, are easier on the ear over twenty minutes and are what the meditation EEG studies used, so the presets default there. Raise it if the beat feels faint.

Tone
50%

Pure is a single sine per ear, the cleanest stimulus. Warm adds two quiet harmonics for a rounder tone; they carry the beat at twice and three times the rate as well, which some people find richer and purists avoid.

Noise bed
50%

Pink noise masks the room and softens a bare sine. Brown is lower and warmer, better for sleep. Masking neither helps nor hurts the beat itself; keep it for comfort or turn it off.

Breath

Five or six breaths a minute is the pace at which heart-rate variability peaks. A longer exhale than inhale leans parasympathetic; box breathing keeps you alert.

Bells

An interval bell is a soft return to the breath partway through, the classic mindfulness-timer cue.

Headphones
Volume
80%
Not a medical device. Keep the volume low and never use while driving. If you have epilepsy, a seizure history, or a heart-rhythm condition, ask a clinician before using entrainment audio. The presets are session designs built on the evidence above, not prescriptions. Your practice log never leaves this device.
